verdict.rationale: A probe confirms cubic publishes a live llms.txt (HTTP 200 at docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt) with a summary and docs index, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs are also served as .md pages, and there is an agent-setup guide (cubic-docs-15). missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, no independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: cubic reviews code on GitHub and in local coding workflows. These docs cover review setup
